summary: ComplyStack 7-step SME insurance discovery journey tested end-to-end. All 7 steps traversed successfully with no console errors. State persistence (localStorage), live summary sidebar, conditional logic, multi-selects, file flow, and JSON download all working.
passed: App loads at / with ComplyStack header and 7-step progress stepper
Step 1: business-name-input accepts text; category card click reveals activity-select; activity option selectable; Continue enabled and advances
Live summary sidebar updates with business name, activity, team/revenue tiles
Step 2: headcount/payroll/revenue pills clickable; snapshot reward reflects selections
Step 3: 9 priority cards render as multi-select; 8 followup fields appear for selections; 'I'm not sure' option present and clickable
Step 4: ownership-* and location-type-* pills clickable; advances
Step 5: has-insurance-yes reveals 13 insurance-type-* options; multi-select works; ownership-structure-* works
Step 6: evidence step accessible and advances
Step 7: considerations-list rendered; summary-download-btn triggers download of 'complystack-protection-summary.json'; edit-business-btn jumps back to Step 1
localStorage persistence verified: 'Acme Textiles Pvt Ltd' preserved after navigating back via step-tab-1
step-tab-N navigation jumps between steps as expected
Zero console errors across full journey
notes: Backend testing was explicitly skipped per request (frontend-only app with localStorage). File upload 'AI analysis' is intentionally simulated/MOCKED client-side and clearly labelled as a demo preliminary read — per product requirement, not a bug. Minor observation: after clicking edit-business-btn then jumping to step-tab-3, the live summary panel showed the empty state until data was re-interacted with; did not block any flow and may be expected rendering.
